summary: Teaches adding, configuring, testing and querying an Elasticsearch data source in Grafana.

needs.description: Running Elasticsearch (v7.17+/8/9) reachable from Grafana Cloud, e.g. via PDC, with an index matching logs-* and @timestamp time field containing documents
needs.evidence: Before you begin: Elasticsearch instance running and accessible; typed logs-* and @timestamp

needs.description: Read credentials (user/password or API key) for that Elasticsearch
needs.evidence: Before you begin: authentication credentials with read access

needs.description: Network path from Cloud to Elasticsearch (public endpoint or Private data source connect agent)
needs.evidence: Before you begin: network access via PDC

needs.description: Org Admin user (targeting userRole Admin; only admins add data sources)

reviewNotes: Path creates the data source itself; the external server is required for test-connection and explore-data to pass. Placeholder URL http://elasticsearch.example.com:9200 is typed literally; test will need a real URL substituted or fail at Save & test.
